surface: Stable React Spring web target at the package root and Parallax through the ./parallax subpath. The port provides spring values, controllers, interpolation, Octane hooks and render-prop components, animated DOM hosts, browser observers, SSR-safe initial rendering, and Parallax scrolling.
divergences: React renderables and refs are represented by Octane renderables and refs-as-props.
The all-renderer react-spring meta-package is intentionally not mapped.
ssr: Initial and immediate values render on the server; browser observers and frame work start after client commit.
notes: All 26 pinned upstream test files have machine-checked adapted or reused dispositions.
Development and production playground journeys cover animation, interruption, keyed transitions, reduced motion, Parallax, and route-away cleanup.
Renderer targets for native, Three, Konva, and Zdog are outside this binding.
